article_context: 从“美国制造业衰退”的常见叙事转向劳动力短缺：婴儿潮一代退休、年轻人兴趣不足、父母对制造业衰退的记忆以及工作生活平衡诉求，共同造成制造企业招工困难。

article.title: 新题型 Part B · 美国制造业的新难题：招不到年轻工人
article.background: 从“美国制造业衰退”的常见叙事转向劳动力短缺：婴儿潮一代退休、年轻人兴趣不足、父母对制造业衰退的记忆以及工作生活平衡诉求，共同造成制造企业招工困难。

sentences.en: The decline in American manufacturing is a common refrain, particularly from Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 美国制造业衰退是一个常被反复提起的话题，唐纳德·特朗普尤其如此。

segments.text: The decline in American manufacturing is a common refrain, particularly from Donald Trump.

sentences.en: "We don't make anything anymore," he told Fox News, while defending his own made-in-Mexico clothing line.
sentences.zh: 他一边为自己那条“墨西哥制造”的服装产品线辩护，一边对福克斯新闻说：“我们现在什么都不生产了。”

segments.text: "We don't make anything anymore," he told Fox News, while defending his own made-in-Mexico clothing line.

sentences.en: Without question, manufacturing has taken a significant hit during recent decades, and further trade deals raise questions about whether new shocks could hit manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，过去几十年制造业遭受了重大冲击，而进一步的贸易协定也令人担心制造业是否还会受到新的冲击。

segments.text: Without question, manufacturing has taken a significant hit during recent decades, and further trade deals raise questions about whether new shocks could hit manufacturing.

sentences.en: But there is also a different way to look at the data.
sentences.zh: 不过，这些数据也可以换一个角度来看。

segments.text: But there is also a different way to look at the data.

sentences.en: Across the country, factory owners are now grappling with a new challenge: Instead of having too many workers, they may end up with too few.
sentences.zh: 如今，全美各地的工厂主正面临一个新难题：他们的问题可能不再是工人太多，而是最终工人太少。

segments.text: Across the country, factory owners are now grappling with a new challenge: Instead of having too many workers, they may end up with too few.

sentences.en: Despite trade competition and outsourcing, American manufacturing still needs to replace tens of thousands of retiring boomers every year.
sentences.zh: 尽管面临贸易竞争和外包，美国制造业每年仍需要补上数以万计退休婴儿潮一代留下的岗位。

segments.text: Despite trade competition and outsourcing, American manufacturing still needs to replace tens of thousands of retiring boomers every year.

sentences.en: Millennials may not be that interested in taking their place.
sentences.zh: 千禧一代未必有多大兴趣接替这些岗位。

segments.text: Millennials may not be that interested in taking their place.

sentences.en: Other industries are recruiting them with similar or better pay.
sentences.zh: 其他行业正用相近甚至更高的薪酬争抢这些年轻人。

segments.text: Other industries are recruiting them with similar or better pay.

sentences.en: For factory owners, it all adds up to stiff competition for workers - and upward pressure on wages.
sentences.zh: 对工厂主来说，这一切意味着对劳动力的激烈争夺，也意味着工资面临上涨压力。

segments.text: For factory owners, it all adds up to stiff competition for workers - and upward pressure on wages.

sentences.en: "They're harder to find and they have job offers," says Jay Dunwell, president of Wolverine Coil Spring, a family-owned firm.
sentences.zh: Wolverine Coil Spring 公司总裁杰伊·邓韦尔说：“他们更难找，而且手里都有工作邀约。”

segments.text: "They're harder to find and they have job offers," says Jay Dunwell, president of Wolverine Coil Spring, a family-owned firm.

sentences.en: "They may be coming [into the workforce], but they've been plucked by other industries that are also doing as well as manufacturing."
sentences.zh: “他们可能确实进入了劳动力市场，但那些同样发展不错的其他行业已经把他们抢走了。”

segments.text: "They may be coming [into the workforce], but they've been plucked by other industries that are also doing as well as manufacturing."

sentences.en: Mr. Dunwell has begun bringing high school juniors to the factory so they can get exposed to its culture.
sentences.zh: 邓韦尔先生已经开始把高中三年级学生带到工厂，让他们接触工厂文化。

segments.text: Mr. Dunwell has begun bringing high school juniors to the factory so they can get exposed to its culture.

sentences.en: At RoMan Manufacturing, a maker of electrical transformers and welding equipment that his father cofounded in 1980, Robert Roth keeps a close eye on the age of his nearly 200 workers.
sentences.zh: 在 RoMan Manufacturing——一家由罗伯特·罗斯的父亲于1980年共同创办、生产变压器和焊接设备的企业——罗斯密切关注着公司近200名员工的年龄。

segments.text: At RoMan Manufacturing, a maker of electrical transformers and welding equipment that his father cofounded in 1980, Robert Roth keeps a close eye on the age of his nearly 200 workers.

sentences.en: Five are retiring this year.
sentences.zh: 其中有5人今年退休。

segments.text: Five are retiring this year.

sentences.en: Mr. Roth has three community-college students enrolled in a work-placement program, with a starting wage of $13 an hour that rises to $17 after two years.
sentences.zh: 罗斯先生让3名社区学院学生参加了一个实习就业项目，起薪为每小时13美元，两年后会涨到17美元。

segments.text: Mr. Roth has three community-college students enrolled in a work-placement program, with a starting wage of $13 an hour that rises to $17 after two years.

sentences.en: At a worktable inside the transformer plant, young Jason Stenquist looks flustered by the copper coils he's trying to assemble and the arrival of two visitors.
sentences.zh: 在变压器工厂的一张工作台前，年轻的杰森·斯滕奎斯特一边组装铜线圈，一边又遇到两位来访者，显得有些手忙脚乱。

segments.text: At a worktable inside the transformer plant, young Jason Stenquist looks flustered by the copper coils he's trying to assemble and the arrival of two visitors.

sentences.en: It's his first week on the job.
sentences.zh: 这是他上班的第一周。

segments.text: It's his first week on the job.

sentences.en: Asked about his choice of career, he says at high school he considered medical school before switching to electrical engineering.
sentences.zh: 谈到职业选择时，他说自己高中时曾考虑学医，后来转而选择电气工程。

segments.text: Asked about his choice of career, he says at high school he considered medical school before switching to electrical engineering.

sentences.en: "I love working with tools.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢和工具打交道。

segments.text: "I love working with tools.

sentences.en: I love creating," he says.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢创造东西。”他说。

segments.text: I love creating," he says.

sentences.en: But to win over these young workers, manufacturers have to clear another major hurdle: parents, who lived through the worst US economic downturn since the Great Depression, telling them to avoid the factory.
sentences.zh: 但要争取这些年轻工人，制造商还必须跨过另一道大坎：他们的父母经历过美国自大萧条以来最严重的经济衰退，因此会告诫孩子远离工厂。

segments.text: But to win over these young workers, manufacturers have to clear another major hurdle: parents, who lived through the worst US economic downturn since the Great Depression, telling them to avoid the factory.

sentences.en: Millennials "remember their father and mother both were laid off.
sentences.zh: 千禧一代“记得自己的父亲和母亲都曾被裁员。

segments.text: Millennials "remember their father and mother both were laid off.

sentences.en: They blame it on the manufacturing recession," says Birgit Klohs, chief executive of The Right Place, a business development agency for western Michigan.
sentences.zh: 他们把这归咎于制造业衰退。”密歇根州西部商业发展机构 The Right Place 的首席执行官比尔吉特·克洛斯说。

segments.text: They blame it on the manufacturing recession," says Birgit Klohs, chief executive of The Right Place, a business development agency for western Michigan.

sentences.en: These concerns aren't misplaced: Employment in manufacturing has fallen from 17 million in 1970 to 12 million in 2015.
sentences.zh: 这种担忧并非毫无根据：制造业就业人数已从1970年的1700万降至2015年的1200万。

segments.text: These concerns aren't misplaced: Employment in manufacturing has fallen from 17 million in 1970 to 12 million in 2015.

sentences.en: When the recovery began, worker shortages first appeared in the high-skilled trades.
sentences.zh: 经济开始复苏时，劳动力短缺最先出现在高技能工种。

segments.text: When the recovery began, worker shortages first appeared in the high-skilled trades.

sentences.en: Now shortages are appearing at the mid-skill levels.
sentences.zh: 如今，中等技能岗位也开始出现短缺。

segments.text: Now shortages are appearing at the mid-skill levels.

sentences.en: "The gap is between the jobs that take no skills and those that require a lot of skill," says Rob Spohr, a business professor at Montcalm Community College.
sentences.zh: 蒙卡尔姆社区学院商学教授罗布·斯波尔说：“缺口出现在几乎不需要技能的岗位和要求很高技能的岗位之间。”

segments.text: "The gap is between the jobs that take no skills and those that require a lot of skill," says Rob Spohr, a business professor at Montcalm Community College.

sentences.en: "There're enough people to fill the jobs at McDonalds and other places where you don't need to have much skill.
sentences.zh: “麦当劳以及其他不太需要技能的工作，有足够多的人可以去做。

segments.text: "There're enough people to fill the jobs at McDonalds and other places where you don't need to have much skill.

sentences.en: It's that gap in between, and that's where the problem is.
sentences.zh: “问题就在两者之间的那一档岗位。”

segments.text: It's that gap in between, and that's where the problem is.

sentences.en: Julie Parks of Grand Rapids Community College points to another key to luring Millennials into manufacturing: a work/life balance.
sentences.zh: 大急流城社区学院的朱莉·帕克斯指出，吸引千禧一代进入制造业还有另一个关键：工作与生活的平衡。

segments.text: Julie Parks of Grand Rapids Community College points to another key to luring Millennials into manufacturing: a work/life balance.

sentences.en: While their parents were content to work long hours, young people value flexibility.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母一代可以接受长时间工作，而年轻人更看重灵活性。

segments.text: While their parents were content to work long hours, young people value flexibility.

sentences.en: "Overtime is not attractive to this generation.
sentences.zh: “加班对这一代人没有吸引力。

segments.text: "Overtime is not attractive to this generation.

sentences.en: They really want to live their lives," she says.
sentences.zh: 他们真的想过自己的生活。”她说。

segments.text: They really want to live their lives," she says.
